Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:When any one of you fights with his brother he should avoid striking at the face
This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Zinad and he said:" When one amongst you strikes (at the face)
Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:When any one of you fights with his brother, he should spare his face
Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:When any one of you fights with his brother, he should not slap at the face

This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Huraira and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Ibn Hatim Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) is reported to have said:When any one of you fights with his brother, he should avoid his face for Allah created Adam in His own image
Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:When any one of you fights with his brother, he should avoid the face
